sys_atf_test.name: Day-2 SAM negative: pull-verify is unavailable by default and the endpoint refuses (fail closed)
sys_atf_test.description: fetchIdentityRequest and verifyJws must both refuse in live mode until a tenant wires them — an unverifiable push must never be treated as approved.

sys_atf_step.description: With test_mode forced off, fetchIdentityRequest must refuse — this is the shipped, not-yet-tenant-wired default that makes an unconfigured (or freshly-deployed) instance safe.
Same refusal for the JWS path: verifyJws must refuse in live mode with no signature/issuer/expiry verification wired, regardless of what the caller-supplied jws string claims.

Confirm the deployment-note contract in a positive check: with both x_fed_day2_ops.iiq_verify_endpoint and x_fed_day2_ops.sam_jws_public_key unset, an operator reading the two properties can see up front why every push will be refused — this is intended, not a misconfiguration to silently work around.
